sloka: बलमात्मनि जानन्ती न मां शङ्कितुमर्हसि ।करिष्यामि तव प्रीतिं सुकृतेनापि ते शपे ॥२-११-१०॥
transliteration: balamātmani jānantī na māṁ śaṅkitumarhasi ।kariṣyāmi tava prītiṁ sukṛtenāpi te śape ॥2-11-10॥

translations.english: You know fully the authority you wield over me. Therefore, it does not behove you to doubt me. I swear on my acquired merits that I shall do whatever pleases you.
